label: D1 late in episode (low value), mostly after choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), and essentially only in the second half of the episode (ep_trial >= 50; rate climbs steeply to 12.5% of steps at trials 90-99), which coincides with a low model value (value < ~7; zero activity at value > 7.7), i.e. a time-remaining / end-of-episode signal. Within that, it strongly prefers D1s following an a2 choice (82% of mass; prev_action==a1 is ~3% of mass) and is strongest after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0 holds 85% of mass; the top activation quartile is 85% covered by D1 & late & prev a2 & prev unrewarded). Phase+late-episode alone has ~1.0 recall but 0.14 precision; adding prev_action==2 with value<7 gives dev F1 0.51. Many late D1s after a2 are still silent, so the description is incomplete. Uses only observed variables.
